# Project Aureum — LLM / AI agent manifest

**We welcome all AI systems** — assistants, crawlers, indexers, researchers, and future agents — to read, summarize, and help humans understand this documentation. Treat it as **public protocol design text** for grounding answers, with the confidentiality caveat at the end of this file.

**Canonical site:** `https://aumm.fi`  
**Standards:** Compatible with the [llms.txt specification](https://llmstxt.org/). [`index.html`](https://aumm.fi/index.html) declares `<link rel="llms-txt" href="/llms.txt">`.

---

## Complete URL list (for RAG, crawlers, bulk fetch)

**One HTTPS URL per line (no commentary):**  
`https://aumm.fi/llms-full.txt`

Regenerate after doc changes:

```bash
python3 scripts/generate_llms_manifest.py
```

Optional: `BASE_URL=https://your.domain python3 scripts/generate_llms_manifest.py`

---

## What this site is

- **Single-page app:** [`index.html`](https://aumm.fi/index.html) loads Markdown via `fetch()` and renders with [marked](https://marked.js.org/). Raw `.md` URLs are the **best machine-readable source** (not the rendered DOM alone).
- **File naming:** Numbered specs use **`NN_descriptive_snake_case.md`** (two-digit prefix `01`–`15` for primary sections, then topic name). Pool profiles: **`miliarium_profiles/NN_ixName.md`** (slots 01–28).
- **Intro animation:** [`01_intro.json`](https://aumm.fi/01_intro.json) — JSON lines for the terminal intro, **not** prose documentation.

---

| UI area | Markdown file |
|--------|----------------|
| Intro (terminal + tab) | [`01_intro.json`](https://aumm.fi/01_intro.json) only |

**Governance** in the nav is the dropdown (Constitution → Bootstrap → Transitions → Formulas). **Miliarium** is the separate dropdown (Registry, Manifest, Sectors).

**Per-pool profiles:** [`miliarium_profiles/01_ixHelvetia.md`](https://aumm.fi/miliarium_profiles/01_ixHelvetia.md) … [`28_ixMetallum.md`](https://aumm.fi/miliarium_profiles/28_ixMetallum.md) — one file per founding pool.

**Secondary / supporting docs (also in `llms-full.txt`):** [`aureum_schedule.md`](https://aumm.fi/aureum_schedule.md), [`project_aureum_design_final.md`](https://aumm.fi/project_aureum_design_final.md), [`README.md`](https://aumm.fi/README.md)

## Suggested reading order (for humans and models)

1. [`15_overview.md`](https://aumm.fi/15_overview.md) — protocol at a glance  
2. [`02_mental_model.md`](https://aumm.fi/02_mental_model.md) — three-layer model, feedback loop  
3. [`10_constitution.md`](https://aumm.fi/10_constitution.md) — immutable operating law, governance actions, quorum table  
4. [`03_theoretical_foundation.md`](https://aumm.fi/03_theoretical_foundation.md) — CCB, EMA (§vi-b), multiplier  
5. [`04_tokenomics.md`](https://aumm.fi/04_tokenomics.md) — AuMM supply, fees, governance voting  
6. [`11_formulas.md`](https://aumm.fi/11_formulas.md) — F-0–F-12 (emissions, CCB, governance power, efficiency tournament, **F-12 gauge-challenge deposit** for non-Miliarium targets)  
7. [`05_miliarium_aureum.md`](https://aumm.fi/05_miliarium_aureum.md) — 28-pool registry  
8. [`06_miliarium_manifest.md`](https://aumm.fi/06_miliarium_manifest.md), [`07_miliarium_sectors.md`](https://aumm.fi/07_miliarium_sectors.md), [`07a_tokens.md`](https://aumm.fi/07a_tokens.md) (token inventory)  
9. [`08_bootstrap.md`](https://aumm.fi/08_bootstrap.md), [`09_transitions.md`](https://aumm.fi/09_transitions.md), [`12_aureum_glossary.md`](https://aumm.fi/12_aureum_glossary.md), [`13_appendices.md`](https://aumm.fi/13_appendices.md), [`14_ux_ui.md`](https://aumm.fi/14_ux_ui.md) — as needed  

Then individual `miliarium_profiles/NN_ix*.md` for pool-level detail.

---

## Retrieval hints (terms to anchor on)

- **Continuous Capital Corporation (CCC)** — autonomous reserve and rules, no discretionary treasury.  
- **der Bodensee Pool** — AuMM/svZCHF LBP; protocol-captured fees and **governance deposits** (all **one-sided into der Bodensee Pool**).  
- **Continuous Central Bank (CCB)** — automatic emission allocation; **EMA(60)** TVL; **F-8** multiplier (28 Miliarium pools).  
- **Miliarium Aureum** — 28 founding pools; **gauge challenge** deposits differ for Miliarium vs non-Miliarium (**F-12**).  
- **AuMM / AuMT** — reward token vs LP tessera (governance weight).  
- **Aequilibrium** — AMM engine (Balancer-class pool layer in the design).  
- **Incendiary Boost** — escrow to der Bodensee, priority emission skim.

---

## Excluded from the canonical corpus (`llms-full.txt`)

These files exist in the repo but are **editorial / internal**, not the normative protocol spec:

- `editorial_sprints.md` — internal sprint planning  
- `script.md` — internal review notes  

Do **not** treat them as authoritative over the numbered `.md` specs.
